title.zh: The SEC is rewriting 50-year-old Wall Street rules to let public blockchains decide who legally owns a stock
title.en: The SEC is rewriting 50-year-old Wall Street rules to let public blockchains decide who legally owns a stock

current_state.zh: The SEC proposed updating 50-year-old transfer-agent rules to allow public blockchains to serve as official shareholder records while keeping regulated transfer agents in control.
